description: Stations de pompage is a dataset listed in Plateforme open data de la Région Île-de-France, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département des Hauts-de-Seine. Localisation des stations de pompage du réseau départemental d'assainissement Ce jeu de données localise les stations de pompage faisant partie des ouvrages du réseau départemental d'assainissement dont le maître d'ouvrage est le Département. Coverage: Île-de-France. The portal files it under Aménagement du territoire, Cadre de vie - environnement. Its keywords are Eau, Crue, Inondation, Eaux usées. The portal shows 56 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2025-12-11 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte (Etalab) (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/wp-content/uploads/2014/05/Licence_Ouverte.pdf). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support drinking water network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-iledefrance-fr-portal.
